text:
leah-fin: Morning 5:12 UTC5 5 batch run for TideBridge: 2 of 4 corp cards declined (large invoice $34,200). Processor code: DO_NOT_HONOR. Need quick plan: retries, wire fallback, and whether to allow short term credit.
matt-payments: Can you post last4? I want to see if it's same issuer.
leah-fin: last4: 6789, 0021. Payment IDs pay_tb1..., pay_tb2... (DMing).
billing-bot: [system] payment.failed count=2 code=DO_NOT_HONOR.
jess-support: Customer ticket #8122 asking if we can accept wire and avoid service disruption.
matt-payments: Proposal: 1) Pause automated retries. 2) Offer secure wire instructions + invoice link. 3) If customer requests, allow one-time Net-7 terms up to $40k while wire clears. 4) Record any credit hold in Zendesk.
omar-ops: +1 to Net-7 up to $40k. I'll add metadata temp_terms=net7_40k and ops_reminder=day5.
nina-legal: Use neutral wording: "issuing bank declined". For wire >25k, run quick compliance check before flagging temp credit. Do not paste bank details in Slack.
leah-fin: Draft to customer:

Hi TideBridge 5:20 UTC5 
We attempted to process your scheduled invoice but a subset of cards were declined by the issuing bank; no funds were captured. We can pause retries and either a) provide secure wire instructions and an invoice link, or b) attempt a single retry with alternate routing. If helpful, we can place this invoice on a one-time 7-day term while payment is arranged. Please reply with your preference.

Redwood Billing

jess-support: Sending message in ticket #8122 now and asked if they prefer wire. Customer replied: "Please send wire instructions, we'll initiate today." :white_check_mark:
matt-payments: Cancelling retries and marking payments awaiting_wire. Setting temp_terms=net7_40k per omar-ops.
billing-bot: [system] invoice.link created https://redwood-invoices/local/ln_tide-8122 (expires 7 days). compliance.notify created reason=wire_gt_25k account=acct_tidebridge
leah-fin: Billing note added: "Retries paused; invoice link + wire instructions sent; temp_terms net7_40k approved; awaiting wire."
nina-legal: Once wire confirmation arrives, attach proof to Zendesk and clear temp hold.
omar-ops: I'll review on day 5. Thanks team.
leah-fin: Closing thread  status: customer chose wire, invoice link sent, retries paused, temp term set. Will update when wire clears.
